imports_page_subtitle: Bring templates, contacts and team members over from another product.
imports_empty_body: Start from the Templates, Contacts or Team page, or upload an export here if you are not sure what it is.
imports_start_unknown_intent: That is not something this page can import.
imports_start_unknown: I have an export and I am not sure what it is
imports_run_not_found: This import could not be found. It may have been discarded.
imports_upload_hint: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or a template export (.json)
imports_source_replace_note: To bring in a different file, start a new import from the Imports page. Replacing the file here would throw away every correction made since it was read.
imports_upload_authorize: Keep this file so I can change the column mapping and come back to this page later.
imports_upload_authorize_help: We store it with your inspection files. It is deleted with this import.
imports_upload_staff_authorize: If nothing here can read it, let someone on the support team open it and convert it.
imports_upload_staff_authorize_help: This file may contain your clients' names, email addresses and phone numbers.
imports_upload_needs_authorize: Agree to us keeping the file, so this import can be picked up again later.
imports_upload_needs_staff_authorize: Agree to someone on the support team opening the file, because nothing here can read it.
imports_mapping_needs_name: Choose which column holds the name.
imports_repair_fix_first: Entries that still cannot be imported: {count}.
imports_invites_sent: {sent} invitations sent, {failed} could not be delivered.
imports_revert_confirm_body: Everything this import created or replaced will be taken back. Anything that cannot be taken back will be listed.
imports_abandon_confirm_body: The file you uploaded and everything prepared from it will be deleted. Nothing has been imported yet.
imports_assistance_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_assistance_body: Let someone on the support team open it and convert it for you. You will review what they send back before anything is imported.
imports_assistance_waiting: We have your file and will convert it. You will be told when it is ready to review.
imports_unsupported_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_unsupported_body: This import accepts a Spectora template export (JSON), or a spreadsheet saved as CSV or Excel.
